definition: The voice is the invariant; the tracks are the variety. Every route to publication shares a single register (the staved-finger voice); tracks differ only in format scaffolding.

Every track passes through one voice pass before publication, done by one consistent processor — never by committee, never by stitching outputs from different processors. The seam test: read two adjacent paragraphs aloud; if you can hear the join, one was voiced by a different processor.
dump → assimilate → assess → draft. New material lands in assets/, gets a brief proposing a track, gets assessed, then gets drafted from scratch (asset as source, not text to rewrite).
A brief is a plan to do something; an asset is material to process. They do not live in the same place — assets in assets/, briefs in briefs/.
Fix what's cheap now; brief what's expensive; never let a barnacle sit unexamined. The build passing is necessary but not sufficient; a human reading the rendered output is the ground truth.
Memory is a research tool (input); documentation is the editorial authority (git, auditable). The yap is research; the voice is authorship; never let the yap author.
Add what the work demands, when the work demands it; formalise at the second occurrence, not the first and not the fifth. Every rule carries the receipt of the problem that forced it.

A book is a context the reader enters somatically. Every register shift, jarring metaphor, rendering glitch, or broken promise is a contract violation that upsets the applecart: the reader's body leaves the room, the mind follows with a post-hoc reason.

term: Hold two ideas without losing the plot
definition: When a second theme surfaces during a task, package the observation (write it down, flag it for the debrief) and return to the first theme. Do not let the second theme hijack the first. The packaging is the discipline; the returning is the skill.

No task should run longer than the attention span of the person reviewing it. Long tasks produce a bubble reality: the agent's context fills with the task's internal logic, the user's attention drifts, and the task's premises stop being questioned. Rest, take stock, confirm the path.

Finish, then question; do not question and finish simultaneously. When you feel the pull to pivot, tidy-first and defer the discussion to the retrospective. The tidy keeps the repo clean; the retrospective decides whether the direction was right.

Keep the end in sight whilst down in the trenches. The commit messages, the critical path, the principles layer, and the debrief are externalisations of top-sight — the horizon made visible while the agent is in the trenches. Without them, top-sight is a purely internal discipline, and internal disciplines fail under fatigue.

The book's replacement for the 1-10 pain scale. Four zones — Green (known ROM), Yellow (unknown, needs mapping), Orange (occasional twinges), Red (sustained signal) — that map the governor's permission, not pain volume. Action is proposed only at the Green-Yellow frontier.

The book's core method: stop asking what a movement is and start asking what the central nervous system does with it. The protective system is a governor, not a villain. Pain, stiffness, and restriction are calculations, not failures. The work is to give the governor better data.

Layers of inconsistent voices, none of them the final one. Produced by redrafting with a model that does not hold register — each pass adds a new voice layer rather than refining one. The single-voice gate and Rule 11 exist to prevent this.
A convention, file, or reference that has lost its justification but lives on — misdirecting every session that inherits it. Identified by tidy-first; removed when the justification no longer holds.

The boundary between the mapped range of motion (Green) and the unmapped range (Yellow). The only place the book proposes action. The governor charts incrementally from this edge — a sliver at a time, never all at once.
The sub-cortical protective system that maps permission, not pain. It clamps what it cannot map; it releases what it can. It is not a villain and not a fool — it executes calculations, not mistakes.

The z=0 hyperplane — the geometric reference against which the body's internal coordinate map is calibrated. Lying on the floor sets the system to idle and lets the governor re-chart. The floor is not a place to rest; it is a datum.

Generative output that is useful as research (voluminous, full of connections) but useless as authorship (loud, eager, holding register poorly). The yap is research; the voice is authorship; never let the yap author.
